# Model viewer

`model-viewer.min.js` is the self-contained distribution of @google/model-viewer 4.3.1 (Google), copied from the version used by CabinWise. License notices in the distribution are preserved; see model-viewer-LICENSE.txt.

The preview loads this local bundle and the local GLB only. The model needs no external textures or compression decoders. AR and vehicle integrations are not enabled. The surrounding readings are fictional presentation data.
